lesson_1.title: Hello AlgoBlocks
lesson_1.task: Scenario: You are configuring the AlgoTech console. Task: Write a Python function `hello()` that returns exactly 'Hello, AlgoBlocks!'.

lesson_1.title: Basic Calculator
lesson_1.task: Scenario: You need a tool to sum up inventory. Task: Write a function `add(a, b)` that returns the sum of a and b. Add a fallback to return 'Error' if inputs are not numbers.

lesson_2.title: Odd or Even
lesson_2.task: Scenario: Sorting users by ID. Task: Write `check_odd_even(n)` returning 'Odd' if odd, 'Even' if even. Return 'Invalid' if n is not an integer.

lesson_2.title: Grade Evaluator
lesson_2.task: Scenario: Automating student results. Task: Write `evaluate(grade)` returning 'Pass' if grade >= 75 else 'Fail'. Fallback: return 'Invalid' if grade < 0 or > 100.

lesson_3.title: The Constant O(1) Test
lesson_3.task: Scenario: Testing instant data access. Task: Write `get_first(arr)` returning the element at index 0. Return 'Empty' if the array has no elements.

lesson_4.title: Swap Visualized
lesson_4.task: Scenario: Correcting mislabeled boxes. Task: Write `swap(a, b)` returning a list [b, a].
